note: Committed BEFORE loading any tumor expression/protein/phospho data. Only cptac.get_cancer_options() (catalog) had been called.

scoring.primary: Fraction of 9 cancers where protein-level mito-biogenesis MACHINERY direction (tumor vs normal, Hedges g sign) matches the predicted sign. Predicted DOWN counts as hit if g<0 AND p<0.05; a non-significant result counts as MISS for a directional prediction (conservative).
scoring.confidence_weighted: Report hit rate separately for high-confidence (coad,gbm,pdac) vs moderate vs low-confidence predictions. The high-confidence set is the real test; low-confidence (ov,ucec) are pre-declared as most likely to miss.
scoring.specificity_prediction: Non-trivial prediction: mito-biogenesis and ribosome-anabolism DISSOCIATE (opposite signs) in tumor. Scored as fraction of cancers where mito g<0 while ribosome g>0. A naive 'both are biogenesis' model predicts they move TOGETHER; the directional method predicts they SPLIT.
scoring.null_baseline: A trivial 'predict DOWN everywhere' model would also score high on the primary metric — THAT IS WHY the dissociation prediction and the confidence grading are the load-bearing tests, not the raw DOWN hit rate.
scoring.falsifier: If ov/ucec (low-confidence) come back strongly DOWN and significant while high-confidence cancers are weak, the biology rationale was wrong even if the aggregate hit rate is high.

predictions.rationale: Normal colonocytes are exceptionally oxidative (butyrate beta-oxidation is their primary fuel). Tumor Warburg shift to glucose => large machinery drop vs a very mito-rich normal.
Normal brain is among the most oxidative tissues; glioblastoma is strongly glycolytic (aerobic glycolysis, hypoxic niches). Tumor-vs-normal-brain => machinery down.
Dense desmoplastic stroma, hypoxia, KRAS-driven glycolytic/glutaminolytic metabolism; poor perfusion suppresses OXPHOS machinery.
Squamous carcinoma with reverse-Warburg/glycolytic phenotype; proliferative epithelium.
Lung squamous carcinoma; strongly glycolytic, SOX2/TP63 squamous program.
Lung adenocarcinoma; proliferative, KRAS/EGFR; net machinery decrease expected though some OXPHOS retention reported.
Breast carcinoma; Warburg shift on average, but subtype-heterogeneous (luminal more oxidative than basal) => moderate, not high, confidence.
High-grade serous ovarian; matched-normal is problematic (comparator often fallopian tube; variable tumor purity) => low confidence, direction may be noisy.

Endometrial carcinoma; PTEN/PI3K driven; a subset is reported OXPHOS-high, and normal endometrium is only moderately oxidative => weakest/most-uncertain prediction, flagged as the one most likely to miss.
